verdict.rationale: Increase documents per-item API calls such as `POST /ach_transfers` and `POST /wire_transfers`, and lets you create many Account Numbers programmatically, but nothing in the pack describes a bulk or batch endpoint that acts on many items in one operation. The 'batch processing' mention refers to listing Events as an alternative to webhooks, which is an adjacent read pattern, not bulk operations on items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
